manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Lumbering Battlement must be exiled by Phantom Steed, and Changeling Berserker must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Changeling Berserker for its mana cost.
When Changeling Berserker enters, it exiles Phantom Steed until Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Berserker's ETB.
When Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, Lumbering Battlement is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Lumbering Battlement enters, it exiles Changeling Berserker until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lumbering Battlement's ETB.
When Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield, Phantom Steed is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Phantom Steed enters, it exiles Lumbering Battlement until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Phantom Steed's ETB.
When Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, Changeling Berserker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
